q: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.
Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.
Bring pages 18, 20, 21and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.
Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.
Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.
High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.
Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
Collect 8 Fel Moss and bring them to Tarindrella.
Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
Bring 12 of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.
Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging Claw to Korran at the Crossroads.
Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.
Bring Razorflank's Medallion to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.
Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
Oben Rageclaw wants you to kill his soulless body, and then use the Voodoo Charm.
Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.
Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.
Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village wants you to retrieve his grog, snuff and strongbox in Dustwallow Swamp.
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.
Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.
Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.
Bring the Shadowglen Gift Voucher to Orenthil Whisperwind.
Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Collect 6 Fine Crab Chunks for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.
Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.
Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Breastplate
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Wraps
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.
Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
Do a train emote at Talvash del Kissel, and in exchange you'll receive a Gnomeregan Gumdrop!

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Use the Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Give Mokvar your Coif of Elements and Vest of Elements.
Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Belt if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Belt, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Arcane Crystals and 2 Mooncloth.

Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 4 Essences of Water, 2 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold.
Epic Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
For 110 Insignias of the Dawn and 110 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
For 75 Insignias of the Dawn and 75 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Epic Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms
Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
